author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a narrow rounded phone body with two lenses stacked in its top-left corner, matching the reference's proportions. Candidate with r3 lens rings (forced to sit centred by the 9-unit clearance) read as a speaker and was rejected.
omissions: Lenses are solid stroke-wide dots rather than outlined rings; rings large enough to keep an open hole cannot sit in the corner with 8+ clearance.
drawing_plan: VRECT_M: rounded rect (10,4)-(38,44) r6; lens dots (19,13) and (19,22).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'smartphone': rounded body with a shared corner radius.
